The structure of Cu3Ag crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4_1md (No. 143), with a cell formula of Cu6Ag2 and 8 atoms per unit cell distributed over 2 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives both Ag and Cu centers a 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangement, with Ag surrounded by 12 Cu neighbors and Cu by 4 Ag and 8 Cu neighbors, at distances of 2.6541–2.7467 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component containing all 8 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Cu-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, edge- and face-sharing between Ag- and Cu-centered polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing among Ag-centered polyhedra.
